question: What will be the closing value of front-month copper futures (HG=F on Yahoo Finance) on September 4, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of HG=F on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-04. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I wasn't able to load Yahoo Finance or most article pages directly (the proxy refused them), so the price figures below come from search-result summaries. I left out everything dated after 2026-08-14.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the daily close of HG=F on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-04, which is a Friday and a normal trading day. The Yahoo page didn't load, so I couldn't read the latest close. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/HG=F/)
- 2026-08-14: In early September, HG=F will probably track the September 2026 contract (HGU26). This is my reading of how Yahoo rolls the contract; I didn't confirm it. Most August reporting quotes the September contract.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Prices are near record highs, inside the 5.0 to 8.0 range.
- 2026-08-14: A dealer site says Comex copper fell to about $6.55/lb. This is a secondary source, so treat it with caution. [SD Bullion](https://sdbullion.com/copper-price)
- 2026-08-12: The September contract hit an all-time high of $6.7140/lb, then eased to about $6.6335. [Economies.com](https://www.economies.com/commodities/copper-news/us-copper-imports-hit-12-year-high,-cutting-lme-inventories-by-14-49501)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-14: The LME is in a squeeze:
  - The August contract traded as much as $370 above September, the widest one-month spread since 2021, and the LME brought in emergency measures to calm the spot market. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-14/copper-crunch-worsens-as-key-spread-heads-for-highest-since-2021)
  - The cash to three-month spread reached about $434/t, and cash copper hit a record near $14,500/t.
  - LME stocks fell for a 42nd straight day, to 204,975 t. [MINING.COM](https://www.mining.com/copper-price-holds-near-record-as-london-warehouse-bidding-war-looms/)
- 2026-08-14: CNBC calls the overdue Section 232 decision on refined copper the "single biggest catalyst" for the market. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/14/copper-trump-tariffs-metal-commodities-trade-war.html)
  - Commerce has recommended a 15% tariff on refined copper from 2027-01-01, rising to 30% on 2028-01-01.
  - Societe Generale says the Comex-LME premium implies a 14.6% chance of the 15% tariff in January 2027 and a 37% chance of the 30% duty in January 2028.
- 2026-08-12/13: Cochilco raised its 2026 average copper forecast to $5.95/lb (from $5.55 in May) and kept 2027 at $5.10. It expects Chilean output to fall 2.6%. [Reporte Minero](https://www.reporteminero.cl/noticia/noticias/2026/08/cochilco-proyeccion-precio-cobre-2026-us-595-libra)
- 2026-08-05: Comex set a record at the time, $6.7045/lb, on tariff speculation. Reported supply factors include the Strait of Hormuz closure and China's ban on sulfuric acid exports. [Bloomberg Law](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/international-trade/us-copper-trades-near-record-on-tariff-risks-hormuz-speculation)
- The 50% tariff on semi-finished copper products has been in place since August 2025. Cathodes and scrap are still exempt. [CRS](https://www.congress.gov/crs-product/IN12614)

## 4. Base rates and recent values
- 2026-06-24: The front month settled at $6.1410 after a 3.39% one-day drop. [Tiger Brokers](https://www.itiger.com/news/2645853606)
- June 2026: The Comex front month averaged $6.32/lb, per Cochilco.
- 2026-07-06: Copper was about $6.23/lb. [Databoks](https://databoks.katadata.co.id/en/market/statistics/fb73cc493c80e11/copper-price-drops-towards-us623-per-pound-monday-july-06-2026)
- 2026-07-29: Comex settled at $6.376/lb. That was up 3.3% for July and 43.6% for the year to date, with the Comex-LME premium at about 19.2¢/lb. [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/premium-copper-price-forecast-us-tariff-premium-signals-6-70-next-1613908?_c=899230)
- Trend: about +5% from late July to mid-August, which is roughly a +$0.30 move in two weeks.
- Typical variation: this is my own estimate, not a sourced figure. Copper has an implied/realized volatility of about 20-30% a year. Over the roughly 15 trading days to Sept 4, that means a one-standard-deviation move of about 5-7%, or about ±$0.35-0.45 from about $6.6. Single-day moves of 3% or more have happened in 2026, such as June 24.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi runs daily and weekly copper price markets (KXCOPPERD and KXCOPPERW). I couldn't find a market for Sept 4 or any odds published by Aug 14. Polymarket and Manifold had nothing that I could find. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxcopperw/copper-weekly-price/kxcopperw-26sep2517)
- Spring 2026, so possibly stale:
  - Citi's near-term target was $14,500/t, with $15,000/t within a year.
  - Goldman's end-2026 target was $13,735/t, with a base case of no refined tariff in 2026.
  - [MINING.COM](https://www.mining.com/copper-price-forecasts-lifted-for-2026-but-tariff-collapse-still-on-the-table/)
- Cochilco puts the 2026 average at $5.95/lb (LME basis).

## 6. Upcoming events before Sept 4
- A presidential decision on the refined copper tariff could come at any time. It's the biggest two-way risk, because the Comex premium over LME depends on it.
- The LME squeeze could ease or tighten, along with the LME's emergency measures. Late August also brings the shift of the front month to the September contract and its delivery.
- Mid-August: China's July activity data.
- Late August: Fed Chair's Jackson Hole speech; US PCE inflation (about Aug 28).
- Sept 1: China PMIs. Sept 4: US August jobs report.
- Also: the US dollar, the Strait of Hormuz situation, and supply disruptions at mines.
